title: Idyllic birthday
text: Unforgettable birthday, catamaran ride, barbecue, drinks, spectacular views, fantastic crew. Idyllic
author: enricpar

title: Amazing yacht trip
text:
We had the most amazing time on the yacht! I booked this as a gift for my mums 50th birthday and she loved it. 
Edwardo was such a great host, he was very attentive and has great knowledge about the sights. 
I would highly recommend booking a trip on the yacht, it was an incredible experience.
author: Stephanie_H
